strongest_angle: Examine Noah Sheidlower's October 2026 Business Insider report detailing how high savings figures at a young age can still be accompanied by worsening financial anxiety and mindset distress.

key_facts.fact: Noah Sheidlower authored an October 2026 Business Insider report detailing how accumulating $100,000 by age 22 failed to prevent ongoing financial anxiety by age 25.
Noah Sheidlower conducted conversations with two dozen Gen Z workers, older Americans, and financial experts for the Business Insider report published in October 2026.
Business Insider published an article on LinkedIn in October 2026 highlighting that Gen Z workers cannot stop panicking about money despite high achievements.
